# Community result

Add the directory written by `python wmip.py package` under `submissions/`. Follow [the submission guide](https://github.com/dengzhe-hou/WMIP/tree/main/submissions).

- [ ] The run covers all three banks with no missing responses.
- [ ] One inference setting produced the whole run, with thinking off as in the paper.
- [ ] Checkpoint, revision, server, inference settings, precision and hardware are recorded.
- [ ] `evidence_url` links to a model card or run notes.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials or model weights are included.
- [ ] `python wmip.py check-submissions` passes.

Describe any difference from the published protocol here.
